rows.question: Montant total des virements par agence
rows.first_sql: SELECT name AS branch, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM transactions JOIN accounts ON transactions.account_id = accounts.account_id JOIN customers ON accounts.customer_id = customers.customer_id JOIN branches ON customers.branch_id = branches.branch_id WHERE txn_type = 'transfer' GROUP BY name
rows.final_sql: SELECT name AS branch, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM transactions JOIN accounts ON transactions.account_id = accounts.account_id JOIN customers ON accounts.customer_id = customers.customer_id JOIN branches ON customers.branch_id = branches.branch_id WHERE txn_type = 'transfer' GROUP BY name LIMIT 200
rows.gold_sql: SELECT b.name, SUM(t.amount) FROM transactions t JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id JOIN branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id WHERE t.txn_type = 'transfer' GROUP BY b.branch_id
